features: Premium Design & Vibrant Display: Experience premium style and functionality with a 1.85-inch AMOLED display that delivers 600 nits of peak brightness and 410 x 502 resolution for vivid visuals, even in sunlight. The always-on display ensures seamless accessibility, while the 18-day battery life guarantees extended usage without interruptions. The 60Hz refresh rate makes the display incredibly smooth and responsive. Navigating through the interface is a like a smooth boat ride.

Advanced GPS & Gesture Control: Stay on track with Five-System GPS technology for precise location tracking and reliable route mapping during outdoor activities. The innovative gesture control feature ensures accurate monitoring of every move, making it your ultimate companion for active adventures.

Powered by HyperOS: India’s first smartwatch powered by HyperOS delivers a smooth and intuitive experience. With customizable watch faces, task syncing from the Notes app, event reminders from the Calendar app, and detailed weather updates, this smartwatch offers fluid animations and optimized power consumption for a premium user interface inspired by HyperOS designs.

150+ Workout Modes & Water Resistance: Track multiple workout modes, including swimming, with detailed metrics. The 5ATM water resistance ensures safe use in water up to 50 meters deep, making it ideal for water-based activities. Ruggedly built to withstand water and dust, the watch also tracks heart rate, sleep patterns, SpO2 levels, and even the female menstrual cycle, making it a complete health companion.
